text_block_list.text:
A restaurant near the school had been the 
talk of the town lately. When I visited at 
lunchtime, it was packed, and after a long 
wait I was finally guided to a table, but—

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
...I'm very sorry, customer. We are 
extremely crowded right now... Would you 
mind sharing a table with other guests?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Man, sorry about this, really. Come on 
Turbo, scooch over a bit.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Zephyr, is that seat over there 
good for you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The wind skimming across the water 
drifts all the way here—it is a lovely 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nice place, right? It's been pretty 
popular lately. Supposedly they bring out 
the best in seasonal ingredients—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My... that restless little plant in the 
pot over there, swaying in the breeze, 
looks quite pleased—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, I'm starving! Let's order food 
already!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Let's look at the menu first, 
alright?

After placing our orders, the dishes were 
brought out after a short while, served 
alongside my own meal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...! Like a gentle southern breeze blowing 
within me— so refreshing, so pure—such a 
tender flavor—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Nature's blessings breathe fresh life into 
every small leaf and fruit... This must 
surely be organic cultivation, nourished 
by rice bran and soil—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a gourmet food review. But 
yeah, I figured you'd especially love this 
kind of thing, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Such a magnificent taste. With every 
bite, it feels as if the ingredients are 
speaking eloquently to my heart—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Deep in the earth, waiting for the season 
of awakening, accumulating abundance... 
until at last, carried by the spring gale, 
they sprout above the soil.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh! Like... *sprooout!* Like 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you don't have to act it out. 
You're getting way too emotionally 
invested in this—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, WHAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—In summertime. Amid scorching heat and 
stormy rain, burning with passion, holding 
fire-like nutrients deep within—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
H-Hot, so hot...! Sweaaat is pouring 
everywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, what is this?! What's with this 
landscape?! Were we not just in a 
restaurant a second ago?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In the season of abundance, savoring and 
drinking in the earth's blessings with 
joy—until the trials of winter arrive.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Dry winter winds and blizzards rule over 
the earth... A world of biting cold and 
hollow silence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hold on, this ain't a joke anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Turbo's... getting sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the vegetables gather their 
strength. Enduring, persevering—for it is 
this season that tempers the fruit.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't care about getting tempered! 
Wrap it up, hurry! Turbo's at her limit!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And then—the seasons turn, welcoming 
spring—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Such mellow sweetness. This richness, 
too, was gathered through a desperate 
struggle to survive.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for the meal, dear 
vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Wh-What in the world... was that just 
now...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: ...At any rate, I'm glad you enjoyed it.

You seem very knowledgeable... about 
nature.

You seem pretty knowledgeable... about 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: ...At any rate, I'm glad you enjoyed it.

You seem very knowledgeable... about 
nature.

You seem pretty knowledgeable... about 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! To have our dishes—crafted 
with such utmost care from the ingredients 
to the cooking methods—appreciated to this 
degree...!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply moved! Please, eat as much as 
you like today! It's on the house!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My... I am honored. In that case, I will 
gladly accept... fufu.

What on earth was that illusory food 
review...? Even with questions lingering, 
we all got to enjoy a hearty meal 
together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I would not say... knowledgeable. It is 
simply that I have spent a long time 
keeping company with plants—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Naturally... just as wind rises, the words 
simply came to me.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Thanks to Zephyr, Turbo wants to 
eat even more and more! I'm ordering 
seconds!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're just gonna brush it off 
like that?! No matter how you look at it, 
what just happened was completely crazy, 
right?!

What on earth was that illusory food 
review...? Even with questions lingering, 
we all savored the meal together.
